nodes.label: Barbets Duet Global Learning Sites Network
nodes.rationale: A global network of learning sites exploring sustainable livelihoods by integrating economic activities with environmental conservation. Grew from Society for International Development (SID) scenarios 1998-2008 in East Africa.
nodes.norm_label: barbets duet global learning sites network

nodes.label: Mosaic Rights
nodes.rationale: Shared, seasonal access to natural resources that ensures communal stewardship over individual exploitation. Inclusive land tenure prioritising biodiversity over exclusive extraction.

nodes.label: Oak Tree Paradox
nodes.rationale: Economic systems that reward abundance rather than extraction - the philosophical basis for Barbets market mechanisms.

nodes.label: The Duet
nodes.rationale: Cross-cultural collaboration on equal terms between Africa and the West, symbolized by the synchronized calls of barbet birds.

nodes.label: CMS Template Spec for Learning Sites
nodes.norm_label: cms template spec for learning sites

nodes.label: Modular CMS template rationale: structured fields for consistency while allowing unique site context
nodes.norm_label: modular cms template rationale: structured fields for consistency while allowing unique site context

nodes.label: Alternating media-text layout rationale: maintains visual flow even when images are omitted
nodes.norm_label: alternating media-text layout rationale: maintains visual flow even when images are omitted

nodes.label: siteSlug Foreign Key
nodes.rationale: siteSlug (not siteOrigin) is the typed foreign key linking Stories, Events, and Projects to LearningSites — enforces a consistent cross-type join key

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4 (globals.css config)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 stores all theme tokens in app/globals.css — no tailwind.config.js exists

nodes.label: Oak Tree Paradox
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: A mature oak tree has high life value (supports 284 insect species) but zero financial value until dead — this paradox drives the entire Barbets Duet mission to invent markets that reward living ecosystems

nodes.label: Column Rights Model
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Western/US model where one owner controls a vertical column from earth core to atmosphere — uses fences for exclusion, optimises for extraction, incentivises resource depletion over stewardship

nodes.label: Mosaic Rights Model
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: African traditional inclusive land tenure where multiple stakeholders hold rights to specific benefits on shared land — uses footpaths over fences, yields high social equity and high biodiversity

nodes.label: Jumuiya (Community with Shared Vision)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Swahili concept for a community with shared vision, values, and goals — the organisational and governance structure of the Barbets Duet network, replacing hierarchical control with social capital

nodes.label: 7 Principles of a Barbet Learning Site
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Distilled at 2010 Nkoroi Partners Meeting: Consistency with Site, Learning by Demonstration, Just Begin, Thinking Step-by-Step, Immediate Needs, Path of Least Resistance, Utu Net Benefits
nodes.norm_label: 7 principles of a barbet learning site

nodes.label: Utu (Humanity/Personhood)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Kiswahili concept of humanity — net benefits must flow simultaneously to individual, community, and environment; the ethical success metric for all learning site activity

nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md

nodes.label: Support Services Bridge
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Critical middle layer comprising environmental monitoring, specialised finance, and strategic communications — connects land-dwellers to complex market traders; without this the duet remains theoretical

nodes.label: Circular Peer-Review Accountability System
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Sites review each other in a fixed circular chain (Nkoroi+Seme→Molo→Woodland Valley→Hannacroix→Mwasama→Himo→Lukenya→Msi-Choke→Seme) — prevents top-down dependency and builds internal professional trust

nodes.label: Site Communications Administrator (SCA)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Role responsible for quarterly reporting in English and Kiswahili, weekly social media narrative, quarterly opinion-shaper engagement, and monthly digital coordination — bridges site activity to policy influence

nodes.label: Barbets Revolving Kitty Fund
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Competitive low-interest internal loan fund for value-addition projects, overseen by a partner verification panel — provides credit outside commercial banking constraints

nodes.label: Barbets Game (Biodiversity Board Game)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Rule-invention board game where winner achieves greatest biodiversity — used to train civil servants (tested in Singapore) and students in biodiversity-centred decision-making; a knowledge management tool

nodes.label: Developmental Hypothesis (2018)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Posits that replacing rain-fed dependence with drip irrigation, water harvesting, and permaculture will achieve transformational change at individual and societal levels — operationalised at Seme site

nodes.label: 20-Year Operational Experiment (2008–2028)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: A structured multi-generational experiment to prove that life value of a landscape can be translated to rigorous market value through institutional innovation — half-time reviewed at 2018 Bagamoyo convention
